text_block_list.text: This is her first shot in the Classic Triple Crown—the Satsuki Sho. Meisho Doto flies into a panic.
Her peers T.M. Opera O and Admire Vega are completely in the zone. On the other hand…
Meisho Doto has her hands full simply adapting to the atmosphere. She spends most of her time tailing after T.M. Opera O.
